title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 6:16-18
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 6:16-18</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="16" /> And <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">when you fast</char>, don’t look gloomy like the hypocrites, 
        </group>
        <group>
          for they make their faces look disfigured, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          so that their fasting will be visible to people. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="secondary">
        <group>
          Truly, I tell you, they have fully received their <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">reward</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="17" /> But you, when you fast, 
        </group>
        <group>
          anoint your head with oil, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and wash your face, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="18" /> so that <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">your fasting</char> won’t be visible to people, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          but to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your Father</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">in a hidden way</char>. 
        </group>
        <group>
          And <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your Father</char>, who sees what <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">is hidden</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he will fully <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">reward</char> you. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
